svg.aria-label: One-to-squillions: log message documents in the logmsg collection, the first with time 2014-03-28 and message "cpu is on fire!", and millions more after it. Each one holds a host field with the same ObjectId, and every one of those references points to the single host document in the hosts collection: goofy.example.com at 127.66.66.66. The host keeps no array of its messages, because that array would never stop growing.
